title: The console's boot animation starts with the CyberUnicorn's

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: 'The web animation is about 1/2 a second ahead of the CYD screen. Try and sync those.'

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE: while connecting, BootCanvas started the page's copy of the boot scene a fixed 1 s after the port opened (BOOT_SYNC_DELAY_MS), and the board's own scene lit up about half a second later. The board prints '[RAMLOG] ... stage=before-wifi-init' right before boot_screen_anim(), so the console now starts its scene on that line (BOOT_SCENE_LINE), with a 2.5 s fallback for firmware that does not print it.

verify.note: Fails when the page's boot scene goes back to a fixed delay.
